title: validation_store names the host through the system device's host tool
intention: Validation_store names the host through the system device's host tool: cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py:165-171 read the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host and nowhere else, so this component names its box on every OS.
why: Akien, 2026-11-21, relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator: "hostname should come from the system device." Folded into outline 6.6.3.7 and 2.3.7.1.5 (branch akiendelllinux/host-door-outline, 97b4ce0b7). Measured 2026-11-21: cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py:165-171 (def host_name: platform.node().split('.')[0].lower()) spell the host by hand, so a box with no os.uname (Windows) or a nodename the roster does not spell breaks here. Child of spanning ticket a577fd03e307 (one door names the host). Ticket 5ccc7f05c932 (READY c9824d056 on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door) builds the door, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py; this build starts after it lands on main, because the tool does not exist on main before then.
traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (the hostname comes from the system device); RULE 1 (the system device's public interface is the tool it publishes); Law 1 (one answer, not N re-derivations of it).
how: Delete the body of host_name at validation_store.py:165-171 and bind the name by `from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host import host_name` at module level, so `vs.host_name` keeps resolving for cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:496 and the tester proof's patch at :121, and the store's own calls (193, 217, 517, 523, 542) read the module global. The tester needs no edit. The os_id fallbacks at :190-193 (platform.system) stay: the sole-door claim is the hostname's (outline 6.6.3.7).

clauses.claim: an AST scan of cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py finds no call to os.uname, platform.node, platform.uname or socket.gethostname, and every host name those files read comes from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host.host_name
with os.uname deleted from the os module for the call, validation_store.host_name() and host_facts()['hostname'] both equal cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host.host_name()

host_name stays a module attribute of validation_store that its own host-seam seal path (validation_store.py:217) reads: rebinding validation_store.host_name to a function returning 'testing-vs-other-box' makes that path end in testing-vs-other-box.json, as the tester's fake-a-box seam (cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.py:121) relies on

decisions.text: D1: each site reads the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host. Delete the body of host_name at validation_store.py:165-171 and bind the name by `from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host import host_name` at module level, so `vs.host_name` keeps resolving for cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:496 and the tester proof's patch at :121, and the store's own calls (193, 217, 517, 523, 542) read the module global. The tester needs no edit. The os_id fallbacks at :190-193 (platform.system) stay: the sole-door claim is the hostname's (outline 6.6.3.7).

D2: the red-first proof cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_the_store_names_the_host_through_the_system_device.py, one tooth per clause, PROVES keyed to this ticket; it deletes os.uname for each call and restores it in finally, and reads no live ~/.cairn.

out: every other component's host sites (siblings under a577fd03e307)
OS-family checks (platform.system, sys.platform, os.name): outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only

measured.how: grep -rnE 'os\.uname\(\)|platform\.node\(\)|socket\.gethostname\(\)|platform\.uname\(\)' over cairn/ skills/ bin/ on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door (c9824d056)
